lines.text: This ruby sold for 30 million dollars.
lines.say: This ruby sold for thirty million dollars.

lines.text: It's a cushion-shaped ruby of 25.59 carats.
lines.say: It's a cushion-shaped ruby of twenty-five point five nine carats.

lines.text: Gem labs say it came from Burma, now Myanmar.
Its deep red is called pigeon's blood, the most prized ruby red.
Labs found no sign it was ever heated.
Cartier set it in a platinum ring between two diamonds.
Sotheby's sold it in Geneva on May 12, 2015.
lines.say: Sotheby's sold it in Geneva on May twelfth, twenty fifteen.

lines.text: The price was 28.25 million Swiss francs.
lines.say: The price was twenty-eight point two five million Swiss francs.

lines.text: That was a record for any ruby at the time.

scene.sub: For any ruby, at the time

lines.text: Its name comes from a poem by the poet Rumi.
One line reads, "The ruby and the sunrise are one."

scene.text: The ruby and the sunrise are one

post.caption: The Sunrise Ruby is a 25.59-carat cushion-shaped ruby that gem labs say came from Burma and found no sign of heating. Cartier set it in a platinum ring, and Sotheby's sold it in Geneva in May 2015 for 28.25 million Swiss francs, a record for any ruby at the time. Its name comes from a poem by Rumi.
